expectation_note: Blind prior (weak: consumer craft has no operational pain) was contradicted on the first run: first-party help-center pages show support volume limiting live support — a real, cited pain signal, fit 75. The product was right and the prior was wrong. Reframed honestly: no score band is asserted here (that would be fitting); this case asserts gate + grounding only, and stays out of the ordering check. Lesson kept: 'has no operations worth automating' is not the same as 'is a consumer company'.
